name: CoreUI Flags
about: CoreUI Flags is a free, open-source icon set with 199 icons designed by creativeLabs Łukasz Holeczek. Search any country or territory name to find its flag in seconds. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0 1.0.

faqs.q: Are CoreUI Flags free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 199 CoreUI Flags are open source under the CC0 1.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC0 1.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which flags are included in CoreUI Flags?
faqs.a: The set holds 199 flag icons. Search any country or territory name above to find its flag instantly.

faqs.q: Are the flags in CoreUI Flags up to date?
faqs.a: Flag designs follow the official national flags as of the set's latest release. If a flag recently changed, check the set's source repository for the newest version.

faqs.q: How do I use CoreUI Flags in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: What formats are CoreUI Flags available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
